description: In `` `${infer A}${Sep}${infer B}` `` the first placeholder takes the shortest prefix before `Sep`; the last placeholder takes the rest.
Two adjacent placeholders, `` `${infer Head}${infer Rest}` ``, split off exactly one character.
A union inside a template literal pattern matches any of its members, e.g. `` `${Digit}${infer Rest}` ``.
`'abc'['length']` is `number`, so string lengths are computed by accumulating a tuple and reading its literal `length`.
